# Kings & Queens Barbershop

> South Austin neighborhood barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Fades, color, waves, curls, kids cuts and shaves on S 1st St. Walk-ins welcome seven days a week, with a hometown feel, good conversation in the chair and a cut that keeps you fresh.

- Phone: (512) 448-1024
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Google rating: 4.8 from 241 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/kings-and-queens-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/kings-and-queens-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Fades & undercuts: Clean fades and sharp undercuts. One regular put it simply: the fade game is sick.
- Color & dye: Hot pink, platinum, whatever you're feeling. Bold color is a house specialty.
- Waves: Waves brushed in and cut to keep the pattern looking its best.
- Curly & textured cuts: Curls, coils and textured hair, shaped by barbers who know it.
- Kids cuts: Little kings and queens welcome. Fun capes and barbers who keep the kids laughing.
- Shaves & line-ups: Haircut and shave, shave only, beard shaping and a crisp line-up to finish the look.

## About
Kings & Queens is a neighborhood barbershop at 4315 S 1st St in South Austin, in the limestone strip center with the barber pole on the window. The doors open at 8 AM, seven days a week, and walk-ins are welcome. It has been around a long time. Back in 2016, one mom wrote that she had been bringing her three sons here for almost 18 years. Regulars call out their barbers by name, Shawn, Shorty, T and SG among them, and plenty have been coming for years. The chairs see every kind of head: hot pink tops, platinum curls, waves, undercuts, beards and little guys in the pizza cape. Reviewers describe lively banter between the barbers and the customers, a hometown feel and "family barbecue on Sunday vibes". One even walked out with a bottle of a barber's homemade BBQ rub.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No, walk-ins are welcome. On busy days you can call (512) 448-1024 to check the wait. One reviewer called just after 8 AM on a Saturday, walked in 10 minutes later and sat down almost right away.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 8 AM to 6 PM, and Sunday 8 AM to 3 PM. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead on holidays.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 4315 S 1st St, Austin, TX 78745, in the limestone strip center. Look for the barber pole on the window. Parking is right out front.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids are welcome, the shop has fun kids capes, and parents say the barbers keep the little ones talking and laughing. One mom wrote that her son with special needs was welcomed with open arms.
- Q: Do you do color?
  A: Yes. Hot pink, platinum, blonde and more. Bold color is one of the things the shop is known for.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: Yes. Cash and credit cards are both accepted.
